description: Descent module of Vostok 3KA No.2, flown on 25 March 1961 with the dog Zvezdochka on the final rehearsal before Gagarin's flight. A flown vehicle.
Flown descent module of Soyuz TM-7.
Raduga ballistic return capsule used to bring materials back from the Mir station.
Technological duplicate of the Kosmos-1514 (Bion-6) biological research satellite.
Ejectable container for experimental animals of the type used on the Korabl-Sputnik flights, including the Belka and Strelka mission.
Mock-up of the Soviet crewed lunar landing craft of the N1-L3 programme.
Full-scale mock-up of the Mir orbital station used as a walk-through exhibit.
Full-scale mock-up of the Soyuz spacecraft.
